hero.headline: Garage Door Panel Replacement in Chicago & Chicagoland
hero.subheadline: We replace damaged garage door sections. Upfront pricing before work begins.

intro: A damaged garage door panel affects your home’s security and appearance. Whether a single section is bent, cracked, or rotted, replacement is often necessary. We replace individual panels across Chicago and its surrounding suburbs. City garages, often in alleys, may experience vehicle contact or impact damage to lower sections. Suburban attached garages can see issues from prolonged weather exposure, such as hail, wind, or moisture, or opener strain on top panels. Common causes include vehicle contact, harsh weather, material fatigue, or opener strain over time. These issues can compromise the door's balance and safety features. We handle these specific repairs for all types of residential garage doors, ensuring the correct panel is ordered and installed. Replacing a panel maintains door integrity, improves thermal efficiency, and extends the door's overall service life. This repair also keeps your property secure and functioning properly. We ensure the new section matches your existing door for seamless operation and aesthetics, restoring the door’s full functionality and curb appeal.
whatWeDo:
A garage door panel fails for several reasons. Vehicle impacts frequently damage bottom sections, bending or breaking the steel skin and internal insulation. Older wooden doors can rot or crack due to moisture exposure. Hail or strong winds create dents and deformities, compromising the panel's structural integrity. An opener can exert too much force on a worn or unbalanced door, causing the top panel to bow or crack near the attachment points.
Proper panel replacement involves identifying the correct manufacturer, model, color, and insulation R-value to ensure a matched section. We install the new panel, along with necessary hardware like hinges, fasteners, and reinforcement struts. Struts add rigidity and prevent future bowing, particularly on wider doors.
The price range of $250–$800 per panel depends on several factors. These include the panel's material (steel, wood, composite), insulation type and R-value, door width and height, and brand-specific components. Custom colors or unique panel designs can also affect the cost. We provide an upfront, flat-rate quote before any work begins.

problemSigns.detail: Vehicle contact causes dents, bends, or cracks on the lowest section.
Older wood panels can rot. Steel panels may crack or rust over time from moisture.
Hail creates dents. Strong winds can twist or deform panels, especially exposed sections.
Excessive force from an opener can cause the top panel to bow or crack near its attachments.

process.description: We inspect the damaged panel and assess its condition. We provide an upfront, flat-rate quote for the replacement before starting work.
We order the correct matched panel for your door. Our trucks carry common parts. We install the new section with new hardware.
We reattach hinges, rollers, and other necessary components. We ensure all connections are secure and properly aligned.
After installation, we perform a balance test and check the safety reverse mechanism. We confirm the door operates smoothly and safely.

whyUs: You receive an upfront, flat-rate quote before any work starts.
Our trucks carry common parts for faster repairs.
We are open 24 hours Monday through Saturday.
We complete a balance and safety-reverse test after every job.

faqs.q: Can I replace just one section of my garage door?
faqs.a: Yes, in many cases, individual panels can be replaced. This depends on the door's manufacturer and if matching sections are available.

faqs.q: What determines the cost of a panel replacement?
faqs.a: The price, typically $250–$800 per panel, depends on the panel's material, insulation level, size, and brand. Custom features also influence cost.

faqs.q: How long does a panel replacement take?
faqs.a: Once the correct panel arrives, installation often takes 1-3 hours. Ordering the specific panel can take longer, depending on availability.

faqs.q: Will the new panel match my existing door?
faqs.a: We order panels matched by manufacturer, model, color, and texture. Slight color variations can occur on older, faded doors.

faqs.q: Is panel replacement an emergency service?
faqs.a: No, panel replacement is generally not an emergency service. It requires ordering a specific part, which takes time.
